questions.q: Why did the President of the United States call the Lambchop family?
options: He wanted Stanley to be in a Tom Toad cartoon.
He wanted to buy their house in Washington, DC.
He wanted them to fly a new spaceship and meet the Tyrrans.
He wanted Arthur to teach him how to fly.
questions.explain: The President needed a peaceful family to take the top-secret spaceship Star Scout to the planet Tyrra.

questions.q: When Stanley first answered the telephone, what did he say?
options: This is the President speaking.
Please call back later.
I am watching the news.
I am the King of France.
questions.explain: Stanley thought it was a joke, so he said he was the King of France. The President even talked about it on television!

questions.q: What is the name of the top-secret spaceship?
options: The Tom Toad
The Star Scout
The TyrraVille
The Polly
questions.explain: The Star Scout was so new and so secret that almost nobody on Earth knew about it.

questions.q: Why did the Tyrrans run out of food?
options: Their plants grew too big and filled the whole town.
They ate everything at a birthday party.
Toxic smoke from Super-Gro ruined all their crops.
The Queen of England took their food away.
questions.explain: Smoke from Super-Gro spoiled the plants on Tyrra. The planet needed a whole year to get better, but the Tyrrans needed food right away.

questions.q: How did Stanley find out how many Tyrrans could fit on the spaceship?
options: He weighed them on a bathroom scale.
He counted them one by one for a week.
He asked the President to send a bigger ship.
He measured them with the spaceship's computer.
questions.explain: The Tyrrans were only about three inches tall, so Stanley used a quick calculation and a bathroom scale to see how many could ride to Earth.

questions.q: What happened to Stanley Lambchop that made him flat?
options: He was rolled up inside a large envelope.
A big bulletin board fell on him while he was sleeping.
He fell into the swimming pool.
A bicycle pump blew him up too much.
questions.explain: A bulletin board fell on Stanley in the night. He was not hurt, but he became only half an inch thick!

questions.q: How did Stanley get to California to visit his friend?
options: He flew there on an airplane.
He rode the train with Arthur.
He walked all the way there.
His family mailed him in a large envelope.
questions.explain: Mailing Stanley was much cheaper than a train or plane ticket, so his father put him in a big envelope and sent him off.

questions.q: What did Stanley let his little brother Arthur do with him at the park?
options: Fly him like a kite.
Use him as a sled.
Throw him into the lake.
Draw pictures all over him.
questions.explain: Arthur was jealous of all the attention, so Stanley let Arthur fly him in the park like a kite.

questions.q: How did Stanley help catch the art thieves at the museum?
options: He jumped out of a box and yelled, "Boo!"
He wrote a long letter to the police.
He hung on the wall like a painting and called out when they came.
He took photos with the museum camera.
questions.explain: Stanley dressed up as a painting of a shepherdess and waited on the museum wall. When the thieves broke in, he called out for help.

questions.q: How did Stanley become round again?
options: The doctor gave him a very big bandage.
He ate a very big breakfast.
He slept under the bulletin board again.
Arthur blew him up with a bicycle pump.
questions.explain: Arthur used a bicycle pump to fill Stanley up, and the whole family drank hot chocolate to celebrate.
